subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should naming stay behind the existing `/name` command or an explicit named-new syntax?
rationale: The implementation uses the existing `label` contract, but it intentionally changes user-facing command grammar that overlaps current `/new [model]` expectations and adjacent session-naming work.

options.title: Accept Control UI shortcuts
options.body: Land the Control UI-specific shortcut semantics with the docs note explaining `/model` for model changes.

options.title: Require explicit syntax
options.body: Ask the branch to preserve bare `/new` expectations by using `/name`, `/label`, or an explicit `/new --name` form for naming.

options.title: Defer to broader command work
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve named-new semantics in the broader open command PR.

recommendation.title: Accept Control UI shortcuts
recommendation.body: Land the Control UI-specific shortcut semantics with the docs note explaining `/model` for model changes.
